encounter.title: Act I Encounter 1 — Square Candidate A (7x7 seed 112)
encounter.notes: LD-003 square shortlist candidate A for Act I #1. 7x7 seed 112 (10 arrows: N1 E5 S1 W3). Multi-enemy prioritization. Grunt W (hp 2, ATTACK IN 3, dmg 2); Grunt E (hp 3, ATTACK IN 5, dmg 2). Initial free W is only 1 arrow (#7), which unlocks the second W arrow (#8). Proven clean path without Rotate: 0 damage in 5 taps (#1 -> #7 -> #8 -> #0 -> #6). Mistake path: shooting East first lets Grunt W attack at turn 3 dealing 2 damage.
